Settings.title: Preferences
Settings.subtitle: Choose how you like to learn
Settings.audioListenHint: Your preferred voice when listening to course content in the Listen modality.
Settings.automationHint: Your organisation can surface short Sudar‑generated summaries (dashboard focus strip) or optional spacing‑style reminders. Turn off pieces here anytime; admins can disable these org‑wide too.
Settings.weekPlanLabel: Show “suggested focus” on my dashboard when available
Settings.spacingNudgesLabel: Receive gentle retrieval‑style reminders (when your org schedules them)
Settings.companionsHint: Choose how Sudar and companions support your learning journey.

Memory.intro: Turn features on or off. Quiet defaults are available by disabling proactive suggestions and idle check-ins.
Memory.pedagogyHint: Explain = direct answers first. Guide = hints and questions first. Exam focus = dense recall.
Memory.memoryLlmTitle: How often AI updates your profile from chat
Memory.memoryLlmHint: Controls LLM calls that infer topics you know, struggles, and style from tutor messages. Your org may set a minimum spacing.
Memory.memoryLlmDaily: At most about once a day
Memory.memoryLlmWeekly: At most about once a week
Memory.memoryLlmOff: Off — do not use AI to infer profile updates from chat
Memory.digestDaysHint: Only applies when long-range memory summary is on. Your organisation may require a longer gap.
Memory.proactiveMasterHint: Turn off to stop proactive prompts and idle check-ins from Sudar.
Memory.idleNudgesHint: Gentle offers for help after you are quiet on a lesson.
Memory.routePromptsHint: Short prompts when you move between dashboard areas.
Memory.sessionStartHint: A quick option when you open Learn.
Memory.moduleBridgeHint: A short reminder linking the previous module to this one.
Memory.supplementalHint: Offers to practice weak topics with Sudar (does not change your score).
Memory.memoryDigestHint: Periodic summary of past tutor chats for deeper continuity.
Memory.inferModalityHint: Build a richer modality profile (e.g. review vs learn). Opt-in; uses your clicks only.
Memory.stuckTutorHint: Lets Sudar notice patterns from quizzes and drop-offs (privacy: not shared with others).
Memory.stuckNudgesHint: Idle and replay nudges informed by activity (requires suggestions on).

Language.sectionHint: Control the interface language, how Sudar replies, and optional auto-detection. Audio voice can be filtered to match your reply language on the Settings page.
Language.uiLanguageHint: Menus, buttons, and Sudar Learn chrome.
Language.contentLanguageHint: The language Sudar uses in chat, nudges, and generated explanations (when the model supports it).
Language.autoDetectHint: When on, Sudar may follow the language you write in even if it differs from the setting above.
Language.orgDefaultHint: Your organisation suggests {locale} for new learners. You can override anytime.

StudioOrg.defaultUiLocaleHint: Suggested for learners who have not set their own language in Sudar Learn. Learners can always override.

VoiceCast.title: Voice cast
VoiceCast.hint: Click a character name to hear it instantly and explore its personality.
VoiceCast.providerHint: Provider voice libraries appear here when fully enabled. Built-in Edge-TTS voices above are always available.
